selected_gaps.gap: Additive; frontier sites dgse and rank: for a moving sensor with memory, a gas sample is generated by exposure along a history, and distinct location/strength/transport histories can induce the same complete sampled record even though their instantaneous fields or fixed-nuisance responses differ. The retrieved mobile methods do not establish the conditions under which the existing joint history distinguishes those locations when the environmental plume predates sensor startup — stakes: the user's UAV can interpret delayed peaks or persistent residual gas as current spatial evidence, concentrating belief at a wrong source and spending its limited search time there.
selected_gaps.companion_rationale: Characterize the source/initial-state equivalence retained by a spatial or order-erasing history summary to obtain O, the observation-visible difference trajectory induced by the actual ordered post-start transport operators; structural_prior_encoding must consume O by carrying one shared initial state through the entire ordered transport/sensor recursion and produce a runnable source estimator. The proposed additional information is post-start transport variation already observed along the fixed controller trajectory, rather than a restriction on pre-start plume reachability; whether that variation determines an identifying physical operator is the load-bearing generation test.
selected_gaps.selection_rationale: This anchor addresses the loss of observed-time structure at the moving-sensor frontier and targets an actual source posterior conditioned on the full transient stream, with unknown initial plume retained. The selected limit-to-construction chain must establish a source-recovering implication unavailable to the steady summary while confronting the occupied time-varying observability, wind-history response and nuisance-profile ancestors: preserving temporal order alone, assuming a known global wind sequence from local wind, or excluding aliases only inside an unvalidated operator is insufficient.

deferred_gaps.gap: Subtractive; frontier sites dgse and rank, shared ancestor steady: whether the steady-field summary assumed by these two indoor source-inference branches is sufficient for source identification when source age, environmental initial concentration and sensor history are not known. This is a question about that branch's inherited assumption, not a claim that every retrieved paper assumes steady state — stakes: apparent gains from a physically structured estimator may depend on an unexamined reduction of the data-generating process, preventing their interpretation as evidence for physical source identification in the user's transient setting.
